batting.name: AJ Finch
batting.dismissal: c KA Pollard b SL Malinga

batting.name: CM Gautam
batting.dismissal: c S Dhawan b B Kumar

balls.text: The extra ball costs them some more, as Warner flays this slower delivery through extra cover
this is poor fielding! Tare has just allowed this to run.. This was a top-edged pull, bounces well short of Tare, but spins over his head.. What was he thinking! Rohit lets out a roar
length delivery, Warner goes for an expansive pull and gets a thick top edge that goes behind square on the leg side. .Short fine leg has to run backwards to fetch that
similar shot, the result is more along expected lines, just clears the infield towards long off
this has sailed over long-on! How? It looked like it hit the splice of the bat as Ojha went ahead with the lofted shot, but this just beats the fielder
short and wide, this is stretching the limits, comfortable wide
slower delivery wide outside off, Ojha chops it to the keeper
Warner has no such problems! This is a half-volley on leg stump but Warner had already made some room.. he smashes it a long way over long on, deep into the stands

caught at long-off! It was the ideal delivery to hit out - length and at a slower pace - but Finch hasn't been timing his shots lately and scoops it straight down the ground. Pollard from long-off moves to his right to take this comfortably
comes down the pitch and almost yorks himself, digs it out to point eventually
he gets under this fine! This is almost to the second tier. Warner moves to the leg side, gets a length delivery and he whacks it with ease over wide long-on
superb yorker on the leg stump, Finch still can't get it away, gets hit on the pads
another yorker, this time Warner glides it down to third man
still not release, Warner punches the low full toss straight to long off
he is struggling to get them off the middle! This was a half-volley and Finch mistimes it to long-off, lets out a cry of disappointment
good delivery from Bumrah again, right in the middle stump line, Warner can only block it out to long off
bowls it almost in the blockhole, no room to get under, Finch digs it out to extra cover
this is a low full toss but Warner finds long-on with his hit
fuller delivery from wide of the crease, the batsman swings his bat but only gets it to long on off the inside half of the bat
good delivery on off, another one in the blockhole, dug out behind point
this one is a half-volley on off and Finch times his cover drive, but finds Bhajji at extra cover
slower delivery, attempted yorker, another full toss, Finch squeezes it out to deep backward square leg
another low full toss, tailing in a touch into Warner, who drives it down the ground to long on
another yorker gone wrong, a low full toss this time and Finch thumps it over the bowler's head for just a single this time
looks for the yorker, but it turns out to be a high full toss, Warner misses out too, punching it straight to long on
slower delivery, it's slow enough for the batsman to get under it and smack it over cover for a couple of runs
good delivery, fired in on the off stump, Finch punches it straight to cover
fires this one in from wide of the crease, the batsman punches it back to the bowler
comes forward and calmly pushes this to cover for an easy single, the fielder hits the stumps an gives away an extra.. It was a close call had the umpire's checked or had the fielder appealed
length ball, Warner wanted to blast it down the ground but gets hurried by pace, only manages to drop it down the pitch, calls for a quick single
poor delivery! this is an attempted slower one but this is down the leg side, Warner swings his arms and manages to get it fine on the leg side
misses out on this one as he cuts this flatter delivery straight to short third man
short and wide, Bhajji is giving away some easy ones here. That has been smashed through cover off the back foot
slower and tossed up, dips and turns, Warner watches it carefully and punches it to deep cover
good ball from Bhajji, doesn't turn and is headed for off, the batsman chops it to point
that last shot has scared him a bit, as he fires this one wide outside off
this has been slapped past the umpire, who was ducking for cover! Short and filthy outside off, Warner plays a down the line winner
makes room and punches the flatter delivery to deep extra cover for a couple
fires it full on the off stump, Warner digs it out to long-off for a single
full and outside off, Finch punches it firmly to long-off for a single
half-volley on off and Warner misses out, inside edging his heave on to his pads
this is a high full-toss that Warner slices through to the point boundary.. Warner looks towards the umpire. It was over the waist, but is not called
back of length outside off, Finch stays in the crease and punches it to deep cover
Indecision! The batsman looks for a single to cover but is sent back in time
shorter delivery, allows Warner to slap it to deep midwicket for a couple
shapes to reverse sweep, but then cuts it straight to point
now Warner looks to thwack it out of the ground, but Bhajji scores this point, as Warner gets an inside edge to his pads
he is lucky here again! Finch charges down the pitch but Bhajji fires a full toss at increased pace, the batsman gets an inside edge to short fine leg
stays upright and punches it back to the bowler
that's a poor shot! Looks to slog sweep it, but is beaten in flight. It bounces over the middle stump
he stays in the crease and punches it on the up to long-off for a single that brings up his fifty
flatter and quicker on the stumps, the batsman pushes it to the bowler
charges down the pitch and drives the tossed up delivery to long off
bowls him short and he will whack you all day.. it was a long hop and Warner obliges by hitting it over midwicket
looks to come down the crease but is kept back by a quicker than usual delivery, he defends
fires it flat on stumps, the batsman punches it to long off for a single
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman pushes it straight to cover
back of length and cuts away a touch, Warner pushes it straight to point
direct hit from short third man, from Malinga.. But it looks safe to me. Finch taps it to short third man for a quick one.. Warner is comfortably in here
slower and straighter, Finch waits for it and defends it down the pitch
back of length on the pads, Warner tucks it behind square for a single
Tare makes a valiant effort at deep extra cover.. He comes charging in and dives forward but is not able to hold on.. Very very difficult chance. .Finch continues to play those inside out drives
tossed up on the pads, Warner pushes it straight to midwicket

trouble! trouble! This is suicidal. Rahul pushes it straight to cover and charges out of the crease only to realise that it was a terrible call a bit too late. He was half-way down the pitch, makes a frantic return but was always going to be short
flatter delivery again, easily punched to long-on
flatter and straighter, the batsman goes back and punches it to long-on
flighted and slower, the batsman drives it to off but can't beat cover
tossed up delivery on off, the batsman drives it down the pitch
bowls a slower one outside off, but it's full enough for Rahul to cream that to deep cover
back of length outside off, easily guided to deep backward point for a couple of runs
digs this one short and beats the batsman as he looks to play an upper cut
he comes forward and punches the length delivery back to the bowler
now Rahul takes the lofted route! Plants his front-foot out and lofts the length delivery over mid-off very very easily. Very correct too
bowls a fuller length on off, Finch steers it down to third-man
takes a step out of the crease but realising he is not to the pitch of the ball, defends it to off
he pushes it softly to cover to call for a quick single
slower this time from Ojha, Finch defends it to cover point
this is a massive hit! Doesn't go very long but goes really really high.. Tossed up delivery, inside out drive.. there is a ring to it
loud appeal as Finch plays outside the line of this arm-ball, might have just missed leg, just

Oh Bumrah! he does so well to run across from deep cover, gets down in time, but parries it away to the boundary.. away from Anderson who was running from long-off. It was a beautifully timed drive off a fuller delivery
full and flighted, the batsman drives it back to Harbhajan
he does it again, plays that late cut nicely, but this time Ojha at short third-man cuts it off
on the stumps this time, the batsman defends it to off
it was slow but this is short enough for Finch to play a cute little late cut past the keeper, runs away to the third-man boundary
flatter this time, the batsman comes forward and defends it to the off
tossed up and slower on off, the batsman dabs it to the leg side and calls for a quick one
superb hit through the infield! Ojha tried the other trick, bowled it full and wide of off as Finch was moving to the leg, but the batsman stretches forward to play a wonderfully timed shot
he moves to the leg side again but Ojha follows him there, he has to defend
high and handsome! Finch moves to the leg side and whacks the flatter delivery over extra cover with a neat inside out drive, it sails all the way
moves about the crease before the ball is bowled, then looks for the big sweep, but misses
he stretches forward and drives the flighted delivery to long off
fires this one in to the pads, the batsman goes deep in the crease and pushes it to deep midwicket

middle stump is out! Dhawan wasn't looking very comfortable and now he has been cleaned up. It's not quite a yorker - some would say it's a half-volley - but this one came in to Dhawan, who went for a loose drive and played outside the line
fires in a yorker that tails into the batsman and Dhawan was not sure of it at all, he manages to get his bat down in time though and gets a thick inside edge to the fine-leg boundary
slower delivery on off, Finch looks to crash it through off but only manages an underedge to point
length delivery on the off stump line, 137 kph, the batsman defends it to mid-off
back of length on the stumps, Finch smartly whips it in the gap at midwicket for a quick couple of runs
starts off with a length delivery, the batsman defends it to cover point
moves to the leg side very early and slaps the quicker delivery straight to point. A meter to the right and that was a four
comes forward to defend, but opens the face at the last moment to steer it to short third man for a quick single
tossed up and slower, Finch presses forward and defends
no room from Bhajji, Dhawan rocks back and pushes it to long off for an easy single
comes down the pitch, realises he is not to the pitch of the delivery, but goes through the lofted shot anyway, dragging it a bit to the leg side to the cow corner boundary
it comes in with the arm from round the wicket, the batsman gets cramped for room and defends it down the pitch
he will do it all day if you bowl him full, gets under the half-volley and lofts it over extra cover with ease. Finch is looking good here
on the pads again, this time he makes contact, flicks it straight to Simmons at deep backward square leg
he targets the leg stump again, but goes too far down
he is struggling with this leg-side deliveries! It's full and on the pads, misses out on the flick again.. Any other batsman would have smacked that to the boundary
bowls on the leg stump line but Dhawan misses out on the flick again, gets hit on the pads
short and wide, he has missed out on this one, chops it to extra cover without any timing
this is the repeat of his boundary in the first over! Full and on the middle stump, Finch covers the swing and drives it beautifully past the stumps
full and down the leg side, I though i heard an edge there as Dhawan went for a flick.. The keeper dives full length to his right and gets a hand to it.. The umpire stretches his arms though
some room this time, but the batsman hits it straight to point
gets on top of the bounce and chops it firmly to the off side, but that's hit straight to Pollard at point
another one which cramps him for room, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler
short of length and comes in to the right hander from wide of crease, the batsman hops on his toes and defends it to off
length delivery on the pads, Dhawan drops it nears his boots and sets off for a quick single, makes it easily
looks to cut the length ball but gets a thick outside edge that drops just short of second slip
another one full and swinging in, this time Finch drives it firmly to mid-off
full, swining, punched beautifully down the ground with the straightest of bats. Neat shot that one
pushes it wide of off, the batsman goes after it already and is beaten by the angle. Good bounce too, the keeper takes it near his face
another full delivery but this one is swinging down the leg side. Finch looks to flick but gets hit on the pads
full and swinging, a bit too full this time and Finch blasts it straight down to mid-on
superb start! he swings this one into the batsman who misses the ball. Somehow it misses the offstump too
sweep end the chase, easily finds the boundary at square leg
they are in no hurry, a single to deep midwicket
flatter delivery on the pads, eased to deep square leg for a single
premediated! He goes down on his knee early and laps it over the keeper's head.. not to the leg side, just over the keeper's head.. straight
more of that! It's a short delivery on the hips and Rohit whips it fine on the the leg side for another one
apologies for saying this - lazy elegance - but that's what it is. Just a defensive push through extra cover and it speeds up after it crosses infield
short of length ball, this time he gets to the other end with a nudge to cover point
crazy crazy! Pollard dabs it to cover and takes off, just gets back in time
superb delivery at this stage! Corker really, pitches on a length and flies past the outside edge, bowled it cross-seamed
can't get it away, pushes it straight to point
he dabs it to mid-off and shoots off for a quick single
what reflexes from Henriques! That was short and was flat-batted back to the bowler, who stuck out his hands over his head and caught it in the second attempt.
quicker delivery, he pounds it on his own half and that sails way over the batsman
slower delivery, very very slow delivery, it's at a snail's pace, slower than a koala, outside off and the batsman misses
fuller delivery on the stumps, eased to midwicket for a single
back of length delivery on pads, the batsman flicks it to deep square leg
another one down the leg side, another wide
no stopping Rayudu! It's a slower delivery outside off and the batsman drags it to wide long on
length ball down the leg side, nothing going right for them here
short ball to start with, Rohit doesn't feel the need to touch it
perfect yorker from Bhuvi! Simmons doesn't help his case by exposing his stumps as he looks for the ramp shot, it takes out the off stick
No Rahul! He looses it again.. This was pulled powerfully to deep midwicket, bounces just ahead of Rahul who just overruns and looses the ball.. Steyn is not impressed
length delivery on off, punched to long off for a single
looks for the yorker but this is a low full toss that is punched down to long on
slower ball but down the leg side, flicked down to fine leg for a single
length delivery on off, the batsman throws his bat and gets an inside edge to single
slower bouncer, the batsman looks to play an upper cut but doesn't manage any contact
that is one powerful cut by Simmons, luckily there is a fielder in the deep for that shot
on the pads, easily flicked to deep square leg
no stopping Mumbai! Henriques gives the batsman some angle and Rayudu slices it over point for another boundary
he is powering them along this Simmons! Comes out of the crease and whacks the short of length ball to deep midwicket
now Simmons comes out of the crease and drives this one easily to long on.. Another fruitful over for Mumbai
tossed up delivery, Rayudu takes it on the full and slaps it to long on
that's salt on injury! Rayudu comes out of the crease and creams it over cover
oh no Rahul! You had all the time. Massive top edge that sails between deep midwicket and long-on. They look at each other but Rahul decides to go for it.. too late, the ball is already on the floor
that was not too far from point! the batsman slices it for a boundary
flatter again, he is just not tossing it up, punches it to long on
he is growing in confidence, punches this length delivery firmly down to long off
it's on the pads and the batsman whips it in the air over backward square leg.. He is not in control of that, but this one runs down to the boundary
quicker short ball outside off, 144.5 kph, the batsman sways away from it
not the best of pulls but it gives him two runs.. He has got fifty! fifty!! Long way from how he started the innings

fires it full on the pads and Rayudu gets a leading edge to mid-off, Rayudu charges in, Henriques takes down the stumps from mid-off.. but he has come in.. almost runs in half-way down the boundary with his momentum
length delivery wide of off, this is smartly done by the batsman, he steers it very very fine.. just past the keeper
length delivery wide of off, punched to wide long off for a single
even better this time! Rayudu comes down the pitch now and lifts the length delivery over long-off with utter ease.. Baroda batsman going after his teammate
this is poor! slower delivery and it's too short, easy for Rayudu to pull it to deep midwicket boundary
fuller outside off, Simmons goes down on his knees and drags it to deep midwicket
another slower delivery, the batsman cuts it straight to point
slower ball outside off, Rayudu looks to hit it towards off but gets an inside edge that takes it to long on
he almost falls backwards trying to play that cut.. Simmons tries to make room and loses his balance, tries to play a cut but he was always falling away from the ball, is beaten
back of length delivery on off, chopped straight to point
length delivery swinging away at a normal pace, the batsman pushes it to cover
slower again, the batsman pushes it down the pitch and Henriques dives to his left to parry it to cover
happy boundary for Rayudu! He came down the pitch early and looks to flog this short ball, but gets a  thick inside edge past the keeper
takes the pace off the delivery, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler
long hop! goes a long way.. Simmons is finding some decent range here. Pulled over deep midwicket with ease
comes out of the crease but defends this one
that has been dragged to the boundary! It was a good ball, nothing wrong with it, but he moves to the leg side and swings his bat across the line to find the wide long on boundary
quicker delivery that cramps the batsman for room, Simmons punches it to deep extra cover for a couple, the throw from the deep was weak
flatter again, Rayudu was out of the crease but punches it nicely to long off
flatter and quicker, Rayudu cuts it straight to short third man
filthy long hop, Simmons fails to take advantage of it as he pulls, but manages to put it in the gap at deep midwicket for a couple
lots of air from the bowler, more air from the batsman as he clears his front leg and hammers it over long on
comes out of the crease and flicks the fuller delivery to deep midwicket
comes down the pitch early and looks to drive it inside out, but hello hello, it's the googles.. he gets an inside edge to long on
flatter and quicker, pushed to midwicket for a single
tossed up on the middle, driven to long on for a single
some extra bounce for Karn! Rayudu punches it all the way back to the bowler almost
this is the googly, the batsman looks to defend but gets an inside edge to midwicket
comes down the pitch and looks to defend as he is not close to the ball
it's the quick skidder now, the batsman looks to cut and is beaten
tosses it up full on off, the batsman gets an inside edge to midwicket
big spin this time! Simmons was looking to cut but gets surprised with the turn and bounce, so does the keeper
he is not tossing it up anymore! on the pads and it's easily worked to deep midwicket
flatter again, Rayudu chops it straight to short third man
flatter delivery, it is nudged to wide long-on with soft hands and they get back for the second
now Rayudu  climbs into Mishra! Charges down the pitch and lifts it straight to the sight screen, effortless hit
absolutely clobbered down the ground! He clears his front leg and keeps hitting them straight, Rahul prevents the boundary
back of length delivery outside off, Rayudu smartly nudges it to the right of third man and calls for a second one early
moves outside leg to blast this through off, but doesn't get the timing, hits it to mid-off for a single
squares up the batsman as this one seams away from back of length, defended towards point
back of length delivery, easily nudged to midwicket for a single
slightly inswing in this one, the batsman comes forward and defends it solidly
back of length on the body, the batsman tucks it to square leg
there is a fielder at long-on but his leap won't do much! Simmons charges down the pitch and whacks the length ball straight over the boundary
corrects the length this time, the batsman punches this straight delivery to cover
fuller now, Simmons moves his front leg out and murders past the mid-off, the fielder doesn't try to get in the way
that is the pace to hit! Simmons moves to the leg side, Pathan's swing follows him, but at 128 kph, it's easy for Simmons to whack over deep midwicket
back of length delivery on the stumps, Simmons punches it to cover off the back foot
that takes off from a length, the batsman is surprised by the bounce as he defends it to off
length delivery on off, it's a slower one this time, the batsman comes forward and defends
not much swing this time, the batsman cracks it over point for a couple, Henriques got a hand to it at point to slow it down
charges down the pitch early and gets a quick short ball, it sails past the helmet
that is a rocket! Rayudu comes forward and punches the ball down on the pitch, the ball just bounces over Bhuvi and races to the straight boundary
short of length delivery, dragged to deep midwicket without any timing
moves to the leg side to slog the short ball but only manages a top edge that lands safely at square leg. Not looking good, Simmons at the moment
moves his front leg out to drag the length delivery to deep midwicket, should have been three, but Simmons was slow thinking it was headed to the boundary
charges down the pitch and flat-bats it without timing to mid-on, gets an extra run as the ball ricochets off the stumps
peach of a delivery! Pitches on a length just outside off before darting away, past the outside edge
poor short! This one is an outswinger that Simmons tries to blast over mid-off without ever moving his feet, gets beaten
superb outswinger again, the batsman slices it to backward point
another inswinger, another time it strikes the pads, but Simmons had moved outside off this time
this one comes in by a mile, hits the pads and everyone goes up - the fielders, the bowlers, the crowd - but the umpire rightly says it was heading down the leg side
bowl the outswinger wide outside off, Simmons watches it go to the keeper
good first ball to the new man! Seams away after pitching, squaring up the batsman and taking the outside edge to third man
doesn't wait too long to strike! Gautam charges down the pitch and punches the length delivery straight to Dhawan at mid-off, this came in after pitching, messing the batsman's timing
loud appeal for caught behind straightaway! This one is on a length and shapes away to beat the bat
back of length on off, Simmons stands tall and punches it to cover
back of length delivery on the pads, easily tucked to midwicket for a single
this one is one of those magic balls, pitches on middle and moves away, but it's full enough for Simmons to get a leading edge to extra cover
he moves outside the leg stump and wants to hammer it over cover, but plays inside the line to be beaten
back of length delivery on off, the batsman defends it to cover point off the back foot
on target straightaway, pitches on length, some shape too, the batsman defends it to mid-on
